Totally get it—there’s a lot to pick from, and it can feel like standing in front of a huge buffet.

Here’s how you can narrow it down:

Pick your box type/size: Log in, go to NEXT BOX → EDIT YOUR BOX → UPDATE CONTENTS to adjust box type, size, and frequency, then SAVE.
Choose your items: In that same screen, swap items in or out to match how you cook—like more chicken if you meal prep, or steaks/roasts if you love grilling.
Check product details: Click any item to see ingredients, nutrition, and sourcing, plus notes on things like gluten-free or major allergens.
Browse specialty items: We’ve got everything from thick-cut steaks to fully cooked options and gluten-free nuggets, all without added hormones or antibiotics and free of 200+ banned ingredients—great if you want convenience or have ingredient preferences.
Look for deals: Before checking out, peek at the DEALS tab in your account for member-only offers, and if you’re new, check our homepage and “Choose Your Plan” flow to see what sign-up promotion fits you best.
Match to recipes: Check out our Recipes and Just Cook blog for ideas; you can reverse-engineer your box around meals that look good to you.

If you tell me how many people you’re feeding, your budget, and what you like to cook (quick weeknights, grilling, slow-cooker, etc.), I can suggest a more specific box setup using these options.
